_README: HORRIBLE IDEAS. The loosest voice on the site: E-Prime gags, inversions,
one-liners. Adding one means appending one object to the array below and
text   the line itself, as it reads on the page. Verbatim.
aside  optional. A quieter second beat under the line. Keep it short, or
leave it null — most lines land harder without one.
The owner writes these. Nothing here gets generated, and nothing here gets
padded to make the page look fuller: Report C's rule on thin states says a
short list presented with confidence reads as a deliberate selection, and a
short list surrounded by filler reads as an incomplete build.
emptyState renders in place of the list when the array runs empty.

jokes.text: I am NOT that I am NOT.
jokes.aside: The owner's, and the one that started the section.
